notes: Read against the maker's source at tag v2.1.2, commit 5b82327, which is the installed version; the branch has since gained bypass handling that the installed binary does not contain. The manual is doc/XOX Drums User Manual.md in that tag. Every jack in the plugin is one channel: the VCV shim at src/vcv/comm_module.cc:31 reads each input with getVoltage and :60 writes each output with setVoltage. Every CV input works the same way, through combineKnobBipolarCV at src/helpers/param_cv.hh:6-11: the voltage is divided by 10, added to its knob, and the total clamped to 0 to 1, so 10V is worth the knob's whole travel and a negative voltage takes the setting down. Every trigger input is a rising edge above 0.5V and the gate length is discarded. THE ONE FINDING A PERSON SHOULD CHECK BY EAR: every sine and square oscillator in the plugin except the hi-hat's advances its phase by twice the frequency it is nominally set to, because the phase increment carries a factor of two (or, in Kick, Snare and Tom, adds the base frequency to itself) while the waveform completes one cycle per unit of phase. M_PIF is pi, confirmed in the 4ms cpputil header util/math.hh:17. So the pitch of Clave, Cowbell, Congabongo, Kick, Snare and Tom is an octave above what the manual and the knob tooltips say. Each of those modules carries the arithmetic in its own notes. Every module also shows an Alt Parameters submenu on right-click; none of these twelve modules declares an alt parameter, so the submenu is empty on all of them and no module gets a menu line for it.

Accent.notes: src/modules/Accent.hh:63 turns the knob into an amount of 0.2 to 1.1, and :47 makes the gain envelope * amount + (1 - amount). At the peak of the envelope that is always 1, whatever the knob, so the accented level is the input level; between accents it is 1 - amount, which is 0.8 at the bottom of the knob and -0.1 at the top. The knob therefore only attenuates, and past the point where amount passes 1 (about 89 per cent of the travel) the resting signal is inverted rather than merely quiet. The manual's claim that the control boosts the accented signal is not in the code. The 70ms envelope is at :55.
